text: Qatar Racing and Equestrian Club has partnered with France Galop since 2008, with the Qatar Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe run under its banner alongside 14 other Group races, a EUR 5 million purse, and the Qatar Arabian World Cup run since 2014.
short: QREC title sponsor of the Arc since 2008 (EUR 5m race)
